about: The falsifier: a published place that cannot fold itself. When a missing extension became a refusal, a lock that names no published place to measure over refused, and every published place is such a lock: it is one. Inside a scratch clone of obligations, `--as manifest` refused with REFUSE·extension e25f5586dbef has no extension, so the rebirth refused and the folder was reset.

cases.name: obligations reborn in a scratch clone, bound folding the folder
cases.said: REFUSE·extension e25f5586dbef has no extension: the lock names no published place to measure it over
